title: lavatera triloba subsp. minoricensis
intro: Lavatera triloba subsp. minoricensis, commonly known as the Minorcan tree mallow, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family, characterized by its showy, pinkish-purple flowers and grayish-green foliage. The Minorcan tree mallow is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax the smooth muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Lavatera triloba subsp. minoricensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
